scope: Add an explicit Playwright resilience and isolation suite to the maintained zero-retry phone matrix
Exercise deterministic constrained initial loading on supported Chromium tooling without claiming arbitrary WebSocket packet loss
Exercise transient offline, hidden/background lifecycle, viewport change, and same-authority resume on Chromium and WebKit
Exercise delayed synthetic Nimiq provider settlement without duplicate wallet or protocol calls
Exercise expired or lost in-memory session recovery with truthful fresh-Practice behavior
Exercise two simultaneous isolated contexts so storage, session tokens, wallet identity, challenge authority, controls, and reconnect lifecycle do not cross
Add deterministic client protocol-fault fixtures for acknowledgement loss/delay, exact-request retry, stale/conflicting/foreign events, and result deduplication
Integrate reviewed project routing, documentation, and compact completion evidence
non_goals: Arbitrary WebSocket packet-loss emulation or claims that browser throttling reproduces every carrier-network failure
PostgreSQL contention, restart injection, reward-store recovery, fake signer or RPC faults, security-header scans, or secret scans assigned to WP-014D
Bundle or timing budgets, verify:full closure, or workflow partitioning assigned to WP-014E
Durable active-match recovery across a real process restart, horizontal scaling, PvP, or matchmaking
Real Nimiq Pay, physical Android or iOS, real wallets, external RPCs, chain modes, NIM transfers, production art or audio, or Sorcerers material
planned_checks: GitHub Actions Verify resilience and matrix

check_results.detail: All 17 work-package records and asset, import-boundary, dependency-license, and clean-room gates passed.
Confirmed that the Mini App SDK remains lazy in the client and @nimiq/core remains server-only outside test support.
5 tests passed, including exact-request retry after a lost acknowledgement, serialized mutation during delayed acknowledgement, foreign/stale snapshot rejection, and terminal deduplication.
11 applicable routes passed with 4 reviewed exclusions after the exact first diagnostic exposed and corrected one stale test-constant name from shared signer extraction.
38 tests passed, retaining server idempotency, ordering, resume, ownership, and timeout coverage.
10 tests passed, including quality routing and unexpected-skip rejection.

All 25 project results were accounted for: 8 routed journeys passed and 17 reviewed exclusions. A three-repeat diagnostic on canonical Chromium and WebKit then passed 24 applicable journeys with 6 exclusions and no retries.
All 150 local Windows logic results passed the one-worker zero-retry quality policy: 94 passed and 56 reviewed exclusions in 5.6 minutes. Linux screenshot comparison remains CI-only.
Compliance, types, server, and client production builds passed; the existing large-client-chunk warning remains assigned to WP-014E.
Built server, overlays, approved-asset plumbing, and join-ID API passed.

The slice adds only test, test-support, routing, evidence, and documentation files. It uses fixed synthetic keys and loopback authority, adds no dependency or product asset, does not alter production client/server behavior, and does not use Sorcerers material.

Confirmed capability-specific routing, zero retries, per-test budgets at or below 120 seconds, exact request reuse after acknowledgement loss, no broad skip, no threshold change, and truthful separation between supported browser network controls and typed protocol-fault fixtures.

skipped_checks: The ordinary Ubuntu 24.04 matrix is pending until the candidate is committed and pushed. The local matrix intentionally ignored screenshot pixels because Windows images are not release evidence; the committed Linux baselines were not changed.

Deterministic bandwidth and latency control runs only on Chromium through its supported CDP surface. WebKit covers offline/resume through Playwright context control; the suite does not claim arbitrary WebSocket packet-loss emulation.
Physical Android/iOS and Nimiq Pay WebView testing was not run; browser automation and synthetic lifecycle events do not substitute for it.
residual_risks: The candidate still requires a clean ordinary Ubuntu 24.04 matrix before WP-014C can close.
Synthetic visibility events and browser offline controls cannot reproduce every mobile OS freeze, carrier transition, or Nimiq Pay host lifecycle.
Active simulations remain single-process and non-durable across an actual Render restart or horizontal scaling; truthful fresh-Practice recovery is the current product contract.
Same-wallet Daily contention, final-budget allocation, PostgreSQL restart behavior, and payout fault injection remain assigned to WP-014D.
